notes.title: Raiden NOVA Update History
notes.content: [p]Ver 1.0.2  Update History[/p][p]Adjustment of score values for certain enemy characters[/p][p]Adjustment of earned experience points for some enemy characters.[/p][p]Correction of the description text in the skill selection screen.[/p][p]Correction of settings related to the vibration effects when defeating large enemy aircraft.[/p][p]Adjustment of hit detection for dropped items[/p][p]Modification of the app icon[/p]
